d:
French pirate Jean Laffite built a fortune raiding ships and smuggling treasure across the Gulf of Mexico. But when he disappeared, rumours of his hidden riches began to spread. Josh Gates travels through Louisiana and Texas, following old maps, historical clues and possible traces of the pirate's legendary loot. Could he finally uncover where Jean Laffite buried his treasure?
Watch Expedition Unknown, Season 4, Episode 13, on Discovery Channel India.
